runtime: Gemini consumer web UI in Chrome Incognito using Temporary Chat

parent_transcript.reason: A fresh Temporary Chat provides UI separation, but no runtime-level evidence was available to establish that parent transcript or summaries cannot enter the effective model input.

sibling_outputs.reason: Separate Temporary Chats can be used, but the consumer UI does not expose runtime-level evidence proving absence of sibling-output inheritance or other ambient cross-chat state.

prior_worker_history.reason: The browser workflow can create new chats but does not expose worker/session internals sufficient to prove absence of retained decision-relevant history.

account_project_memory.reason: The browser workflow does not provide inspectable runtime evidence sufficient for the protocol's PASS requirement on ambient account/project memory.

retrieval.reason: Participant prompts prohibit web browsing and Connected Apps, but prompt-level prohibition is not runtime-level evidence that all retrieval channels are unavailable.

filesystem_tools.reason: The participant workflow supplies case material by pasted text only and exposes no local repository or hidden-key filesystem to the Gemini chat.

coordinator_handoff.reason: Manual stage packets are inspectable before paste and can be restricted to explicit stage-authorized material.

decision: Do not execute or label Gemini browser runs as cg-full. Preserve the planned slots but mark the treatment invalid before participant execution.
